name: Louvre Museum
description: The largest art museum on earth. Book a timed entry and pick two wings, not five.

name: Eiffel Tower Summit
description: Lift to the second floor, then the summit. Sunset slots sell out weeks ahead.

name: Marais Food Walk
description: Falafel, fromagerie, patisserie and a wine bar across the old Jewish quarter.

name: Seine Evening Cruise
description: An hour on the water past the illuminated bridges and Notre-Dame.

name: Père Lachaise Cemetery
description: Free, enormous and full of famous graves. Take a map or you will get lost.

name: British Museum
description: Free entry to eight thousand years of everything. Donations welcome.

name: Tower of London
description: Crown Jewels, ravens and a Yeoman Warder tour worth arriving early for.

name: West End Theatre Show
description: Day seats and lotteries put good stalls within reach if you queue.

name: Borough Market Lunch
description: Grazing market under the railway arches. Go on a weekday to actually move.

name: Hampstead Heath Walk
description: Wild parkland with the best free view of the skyline from Parliament Hill.

name: Colosseum and Forum
description: One combined ticket covers the arena, the Forum and Palatine Hill.

name: Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel
description: Miles of galleries ending at the ceiling. First entry slot is the only calm one.

name: Trastevere Evening Food Crawl
description: Cacio e pepe, supplì and house wine across the river.

name: Borghese Gallery
description: Bernini sculpture in a garden villa. Strictly timed two-hour entry.

name: Appian Way by Bike
description: Ride the original Roman road past catacombs and aqueducts.

name: Tsukiji Outer Market Breakfast
description: Tamagoyaki, uni and knife shops. Arrive by seven for the good stalls.

name: Senso-ji and Asakusa
description: Tokyo's oldest temple, plus the shopping street leading to it.

name: TeamLab Digital Art Museum
description: Immersive light installations. Wear shorts, some rooms are ankle-deep water.

name: Shibuya and Shinjuku Nightlife
description: Golden Gai alley bars, izakaya and the crossing at its busiest.

name: Sumo Morning Practice
description: Watch a stable train up close. Silence is strictly enforced.

name: Fushimi Inari Shrine Hike
description: Ten thousand vermilion gates up the mountain. Go at dawn or after dark.

name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
description: Bamboo corridor plus the monkey park and river boats nearby.

name: Tea Ceremony in Gion
description: A guided matcha ceremony in a machiya townhouse.

name: Nishiki Market Tasting
description: Five covered blocks of pickles, tofu, skewers and knives.

name: Kinkaku-ji Golden Pavilion
description: Gold-leaf pavilion over a reflecting pond. Small site, big crowds.

name: Metropolitan Museum of Art
description: Encyclopaedic collection on the edge of Central Park. NY residents pay what they wish.

name: Broadway Show
description: Rush tickets and digital lotteries cut the price by more than half.

name: High Line and Chelsea Market
description: Elevated rail park ending at a food hall in an old biscuit factory.

name: Brooklyn Bridge Walk at Sunset
description: Walk from Manhattan to DUMBO with the skyline behind you.

name: Harlem Jazz Club Night
description: Small rooms, cash covers and sets that run late.

name: Sagrada Família
description: Gaudí's unfinished basilica. The tower climb is a separate ticket.

name: Park Güell
description: Mosaic terraces over the city. The monumental zone needs a timed ticket.

name: Gothic Quarter Tapas Crawl
description: Vermouth, anchovies and pan con tomate through the medieval streets.

name: Montjuïc Cable Car and Castle
description: Cable car up to a hilltop fortress with harbour views.

name: Barceloneta Beach Day
description: City beach with a boardwalk of chiringuitos. Watch your bag.

name: Rijksmuseum
description: Dutch Golden Age painting, with the Night Watch as the centrepiece.

name: Anne Frank House
description: Timed tickets only, released six weeks out and gone within hours.

name: Canal Ring Cycle Tour
description: The city as locals use it. Ring your bell and stay out of the bike lane.

name: Van Gogh Museum
description: The largest collection of his work, hung chronologically.

name: Brown Café Evening
description: Centuries-old pubs with sand on the floor and jenever on the shelf.

name: Hagia Sophia
description: Cathedral, then mosque, then museum, now mosque again. Fifteen centuries deep.

name: Grand Bazaar and Spice Market
description: Four thousand shops. Haggling is expected, not optional.

name: Traditional Hammam
description: Steam, scrub and foam wash in an Ottoman bathhouse.

name: Bosphorus Ferry to Kadıköy
description: A commuter ferry between two continents for the price of a bus.

name: Karaköy Street Food Tour
description: Balık ekmek, simit, lahmacun and far too much tea.

name: Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew
description: The Emerald Buddha and the royal compound. Cover shoulders and knees.

name: Chinatown Street Food Crawl
description: Yaowarat Road after dark: oyster omelettes, satay and mango sticky rice.

name: Longtail Boat Klong Tour
description: Canals through the old riverside neighbourhoods behind Thonburi.

name: Thai Cooking Class
description: Market shop, then four dishes from scratch including your own curry paste.

name: Thai Massage at Wat Pho
description: The temple that is also the country's original massage school.

name: Museum Island Day Pass
description: Five museums on one island, including the Pergamon and the Neues.

name: East Side Gallery and Wall Memorial
description: The longest surviving stretch of the Wall, painted end to end.

name: Cold War Walking Tour
description: Checkpoint Charlie, the death strip and the airlift, on foot.

name: Kreuzberg Bar Night
description: Späti beers, techno and doors that do not open before midnight.

name: Tempelhofer Feld Cycle
description: A decommissioned airport turned public park. Ride the runways.

name: Prague Castle Complex
description: The largest castle complex in the world, plus St Vitus Cathedral.

name: Charles Bridge at Dawn
description: Baroque statues and no crowds if you are there before seven.

name: Jewish Quarter and Old Synagogues
description: Six sites on one ticket, including Europe's oldest active synagogue.

name: Beer Hall Evening
description: The country that invented pilsner, at about two euros a half litre.

name: Vyšehrad Fortress Walk
description: Clifftop fortress and gardens over the Vltava, mostly locals.

name: Tram 28 and Alfama
description: The wooden tram through the oldest quarter. Board at the terminus for a seat.

name: Belém Tower and Pastéis
description: Manueline riverside monuments and the original custard tart bakery.

name: Fado Dinner in Alfama
description: Portugal's melancholic song form in a small tiled room.

name: Time Out Market Grazing
description: Two dozen of the city's kitchens under one market roof.

name: Sintra Day Trip
description: Pena Palace and Moorish castle in the hills, forty minutes by train.

name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
description: The main Joseon palace. Free entry if you arrive in hanbok.

name: Gwangjang Market Food Stalls
description: Bindaetteok, mayak gimbap and raw beef, at communal counters.

name: Bukhansan Day Hike
description: A granite national park reachable by metro from downtown.

name: Jimjilbang Bathhouse
description: Hot pools, kilns and sleeping halls. Many are open all night.

name: Hongdae Nightlife
description: Student district of live houses, noraebang and street performers.

name: Gardens by the Bay
description: Supertrees plus the cooled conservatories. Light show is free at night.

name: Hawker Centre Crawl
description: Chicken rice, laksa and char kway teow for a few dollars a plate.

name: MacRitchie Treetop Walk
description: Rainforest reservoir loop with a suspension bridge and monkeys.

name: Kampong Glam and Little India
description: Two historic quarters, textile shops and very good roti prata.

name: Night Safari
description: A zoo built for nocturnal animals, on tram and walking trails.

name: Old Quarter Street Food Tour
description: Pho, bun cha, banh mi and egg coffee on plastic stools.

name: Hoan Kiem Lake Morning
description: Tai chi, badminton and the whole city awake by six.

name: Temple of Literature
description: Vietnam's first university, founded in 1070.

name: Ha Long Bay Day Cruise
description: Limestone karsts, caves and kayaking. Long transfer each way.

name: Water Puppet Theatre
description: A thousand-year-old art form performed waist-deep in water.

name: Doi Suthep Temple
description: Gold chedi on the mountain above town, up 300 naga steps.

name: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary
description: Observation and feeding only. Avoid anywhere offering rides.

name: Northern Thai Cooking Class
description: Khao soi and sai ua, starting with a market tour and a farm visit.

name: Sunday Walking Street Market
description: The old town closes to traffic for crafts, food and music.

name: Sticky Waterfalls Trip
description: Limestone falls you can walk straight up without slipping.

name: Angkor Wat Sunrise
description: The main temple at dawn, then Bayon and Ta Prohm. One-day pass.

name: Angkor by Bicycle
description: The small circuit under your own steam. Start early, it gets brutal.

name: Tonlé Sap Floating Village
description: Stilted communities on Southeast Asia's largest lake.

name: Khmer Cooking Class
description: Amok, lok lak and prahok, with a market walk first.

name: Phare Cambodian Circus
description: Acrobatics and storytelling by graduates of an arts NGO.

name: Humayun's Tomb
description: The Mughal garden tomb that the Taj Mahal was modelled on.

name: Old Delhi Food Walk
description: Chandni Chowk: parathas, kebabs, jalebi and the spice market.

name: Qutub Minar
description: A 73-metre brick minaret from 1199, in a ruined complex.

name: Jama Masjid and Rickshaw Ride
description: India's largest mosque, then the lanes by cycle rickshaw.

name: Agra and Taj Mahal Day Trip
description: Express train down and back. Closed on Fridays.

name: Amber Fort
description: Hilltop fort with mirror halls, above a lake outside the city.

name: City Palace and Jantar Mantar
description: Royal apartments next to an eighteenth-century stone observatory.

name: Block Printing Workshop
description: Carve and print your own textile with a Sanganer workshop.

name: Bazaar Shopping Walk
description: Johari and Bapu bazaars for gems, textiles and juttis.

name: Nahargarh Fort Sunset
description: The best view over the pink city, from the ridge above it.

name: Giza Pyramids and Sphinx
description: The last standing ancient wonder. Inside the Great Pyramid costs extra.

name: Grand Egyptian Museum
description: The full Tutankhamun collection, beside the pyramids plateau.

name: Khan el-Khalili Bazaar
description: A medieval souq with coppersmiths, spices and mint tea.

name: Islamic Cairo Walking Tour
description: Mosques, madrasas and minarets across the medieval core.

name: Nile Felucca at Sunset
description: A traditional sailboat hour, negotiated at the corniche.

name: Jemaa el-Fnaa at Night
description: The main square turns into an open-air food court after dark.

name: Souks and Medina Walk
description: Leather, lanterns and rugs. Agree the price before the tea arrives.

name: Bahia Palace and Saadian Tombs
description: Zellij tilework and carved cedar in two nineteenth-century sites.

name: Hammam and Argan Scrub
description: Black soap, steam and a gommage that removes a layer of you.

name: Atlas Mountains Day Trip
description: Berber villages and a valley walk in the Ourika or Imlil valleys.

name: Table Mountain Cableway
description: Rotating cable car to the plateau. Closes in high wind, so go early.

name: Cape Peninsula Drive
description: Chapman's Peak, Cape Point and the Boulders Beach penguins.

name: Robben Island Tour
description: The prison island, guided by former political prisoners.

name: Winelands Tasting Day
description: Stellenbosch and Franschhoek estates, ideally with a driver.

name: Lion's Head Sunrise Hike
description: Ninety minutes up, with chains and ladders near the summit.

name: Teotihuacán Pyramids
description: Sun and Moon pyramids on an hour's bus ride from the north terminal.

name: Frida Kahlo Museum
description: Casa Azul in Coyoacán. Tickets are online-only and sell out.

name: Taco and Mercado Crawl
description: Al pastor, carnitas and barbacoa, plus a market breakfast.

name: Xochimilco Trajinera
description: Painted boats on the surviving Aztec canals. Loud and cheerful.

name: Lucha Libre Night
description: Masked wrestling at Arena México. Buy masks outside, not in.

name: Machu Picchu Day Trip
description: Train to Aguas Calientes, bus up, timed circuit. Book months ahead.

name: Sacred Valley Tour
description: Pisac, Ollantaytambo and Chinchero terraces and salt pans.

name: Rainbow Mountain Hike
description: Above 5,000 metres. Acclimatise in Cusco for two days first.

name: San Pedro Market and Cooking
description: Two hundred potato varieties, then ceviche and lomo saltado.

name: Qorikancha and Inca Walls Walk
description: The sun temple the Spanish built a convent on top of.

name: Christ the Redeemer
description: Cog train up Corcovado. Go on a clear morning or see only cloud.

name: Sugarloaf Cable Car
description: Two stages to the summit. Best at sunset with the bay behind.

name: Ipanema and Copacabana Beach
description: Rent a chair, drink água de coco, watch the futevôlei.

name: Samba Night in Lapa
description: Live roda de samba under the arches. Friday is the night.

name: Tijuca Forest Hike
description: The world's largest urban rainforest, with waterfalls and views.

name: Recoleta Cemetery
description: A city of marble mausoleums, including Evita's.

name: Tango Show and Class
description: A lesson before the show, or find a milonga and watch locals.

name: Parrilla Steak Dinner
description: Bife de chorizo, chimichurri and a Malbec, starting at ten.

name: San Telmo Sunday Market
description: Antiques and street tango along Defensa for a mile.

name: Tigre Delta Boat Trip
description: Train to the delta, then wooden launches between island houses.

name: Opera House Tour
description: Inside the shells, including the concert hall when it is free.

name: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
description: Six kilometres of clifftop path past four beaches and a sea pool.

name: Harbour Bridge Climb
description: Harnessed to the arch, 134 metres over the water.

name: Manly Ferry and Beach
description: The best cheap harbour cruise is the regular commuter ferry.

name: Blue Mountains Day Trip
description: Three Sisters, canyon walks and the steepest railway in the world.

name: Golden Circle Tour
description: Þingvellir rift, Geysir and Gullfoss in one long loop.

name: Blue Lagoon
description: Geothermal silica pools. Pre-booked slots only.

name: Northern Lights Hunt
description: September to March, and entirely dependent on cloud cover.

name: South Coast Waterfalls
description: Seljalandsfoss, Skógafoss and the black sand at Reynisfjara.

name: Whale Watching from Old Harbour
description: Minke and humpback in Faxaflói bay. Dress far warmer than you think.

name: Széchenyi Thermal Baths
description: Neo-baroque bathhouse with eighteen pools, indoor and out.

name: Buda Castle and Fisherman's Bastion
description: Castle hill terraces with the best view across to Parliament.

name: Parliament Building Tour
description: The neo-gothic interior and the crown jewels. Guided entry only.

name: Ruin Bar Evening
description: Derelict courtyards turned into bars, starting with Szimpla Kert.

name: Great Market Hall Food Tour
description: Paprika, lángos and Mangalica sausage over three floors.
